description: The regular five-dimensional full-kernel chart is organized by a scalar and a binary sextic. Thirty exact finite-field samples supply first-normal obstruction evidence, not a characteristic-zero classification.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an exact LaTeX location for every program-relevant defining claim. A locator records where the current statement and evidence boundary appear; it is not a proof-review status.

members.statement: An explicit smooth Z11 residue disk in the regular Jordan-type-(5) collision-line locus cannot extend even to first normal order to a global homogeneous quadratic nilpotent 5 by 5 Jacobian; transformed and coordinate-free exact systems have ranks (60,61) and (125,126), respectively.
members.title: Dimension Five First Normal Obstruction: An explicit smooth Z11 residue disk in the regular Jordan-type-(5) collision-line locus canno…

members.statement: On det(T) nonzero, the five-dimensional full-kernel pencil has Jordan type (5) everywhere exactly when a7 is nonzero; after setting lambda=a7, its parameter space is the principal sl2-module C lambda plus Sym^6(C^2), with det(T)=((lambda^2+4A)^2-96B)/256.
members.title: Regular Full-Kernel Pencils Are a Scalar Plus a Binary Sextic

members.statement: The normalized full-kernel collision system has 6, 11, and 13 rational points over F7, F11, and F13 respectively, and the computed first-normal obstruction is nonzero at all thirty points.
members.title: Thirty Finite-Field Full-Kernel Samples Are First-Normally Obstructed
